name: domain_purchase.purchase
description: Register one second-level .com or .net domain for ONE year through the configured FOSSBilling account and FakePayment simulation. Creates an order/invoice and confirms simulated payment up to max_amount_minor (USD cents in E15). Use only for an explicitly requested domain. Does not buy DNS hosting or create DNS records. Repeated calls for the same account/domain return the local journal, never a second checkout. If incomplete or outcome_unknown=true, use domain_purchase.status, not another purchase. Success requires paid invoice and active registrar order; does not prove DNS propagation.

max_amount_minor.description: Maximum simulated payment in currency minor units (USD cents); an over-limit order remains unpaid

name: domain_purchase.status
description: Read the current account's locally recorded purchase and verify its invoice/order status with FOSSBilling. Does not create orders or submit payments. If checkout lost its response before an order ID was saved, inspect the portal manually. no_local_order is not evidence a domain is available.

name: domain_purchase.set_nameservers
description: Replace the nameservers of your own active domain registration order (order_id from domain_purchase.status or the registrar portal, not a hosting order). Provide two to four distinct existing nameserver hostnames. Does not create registry host/glue objects, buy hosting, create records or prove DNS propagation. On outcome_unknown inspect the portal and DNS before retrying.

nameservers.description: Two to four distinct nameserver hostnames, e.g. ns1.example.com and ns2.example.com

name: domain_purchase.hosting_purchase
description: Order DNS Hosting for an explicitly requested domain through your configured FOSSBilling account. This is DNS zone hosting, not web hosting. Requires exactly one offered DNS product. Supports free checkout or signed FakePayment simulation up to max_amount_minor. Checkout may create an unpaid order before budget validation. Active order and paid invoice (or no invoice for free checkout) are required for success. Does not change NS or add records. Repeated calls reuse a separate persistent hosting journal; use hosting_status for incomplete or uncertain outcomes. Do not invoke concurrently with another purchase for the same customer.

max_amount_minor.description: Maximum simulated payment in USD cents; zero permits free hosting only

name: domain_purchase.hosting_status
description: Read your locally recorded DNS Hosting purchase and query its current FOSSBilling order and invoice. Never submits orders or payments. An active order is not proof of DNS propagation. no_local_order only means no hosting journal exists. If checkout lost its response, reconcile through the customer portal.
